newsitem.title: UK: Russia's Gazprom share offer increased by 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Gazprom share offer increased by 15 percent.

text.p: Strong demand for shares in Russian natural gas giant RAO Gazprom has resulted in the lead managers increasing the size of the company's American Depositary Share (ADS) issue by 15 percent.
The company said in a statement on Thursday that its initial offering of 23.7 million ADS, which was priced at $15.75 per ADS on Monday, will now see an additional 3.555 million ADS issued.
That will bring the number of ADS in issue to 27.255 million and increasing the size of the stock listed overseas to $429.3 million from $373.3 million.
The initial offering was about five times oversubscribed.
Nearly two percent of the company is now in foreign hands and Gazprom has said it plans to build on the success of this offering to get nine percent of its stock listed on overseas exchanges.
This process will start once the company has completed its accounts to U.S. standards.
The company plans to employ the proceeds of share sales overseas as part of a $40 billion expansion plan which will substantially increase its exports to western Europe.
Gazprom's ADS closed down $1.23 on Thursday at $18.15, having been as high as $19.50 in the days after the offering.
